name: @repo/ai-diff
description: Proposed code or data edit where added lines wipe in from the left and rejected lines collapse to nothing.

useCases: Tool call that rewrites a file
Any before/after the user must accept or reject
compositionHints: Accepting flashes the block once, then settles — no confetti
Rejecting collapses the lines to zero height so the space is reclaimed
Line numbers are optional; omit them for data rather than code
